name: pwdev-fumadocs
description: Build Fumadocs documentation sites from the live official docs: setup on new or existing React apps, content and navigation, features through @fumadocs/cli, and diagnosis with a deterministic project scanner — verified by type-check and build.

interface.shortDescription: Fumadocs setup, content, features and diagnosis
interface.longDescription: Create a Fumadocs site or add Fumadocs to an existing Next.js, React Router, TanStack Start, Waku or Astro app; write and organize MDX pages and meta.json navigation; add search, llms.txt, an MCP server, OG images, OpenAPI, i18n or static export through @fumadocs/cli or the official page; and diagnose build and runtime errors. Every code change follows the live Fumadocs documentation and is verified by type-check and build.
defaultPrompt: Add Fumadocs docs under /docs to this Next.js app.
Organize content/docs into tabs for Guides and API Reference.
Add llms.txt and an MCP server to these docs, then verify the routes.
